# Kyrgyzstan world

The campaign contains 35 stops, seven oblasts and 45 illustrated landmarks. Town locations and regional outlines provide a geographic teaching map. Pass barriers, tunnel shortcuts, route speeds and vehicle unlocks are simplified gameplay systems; proposed player routes do not represent actual transport infrastructure.

Regional boundaries: geoBoundaries gbOpen KGZ ADM1 (2017), sourced from OpenStreetMap / Wambacher under ODbL. The original GeoJSON is preserved alongside the projected game data. Attribution is displayed on the map.

- [geoBoundaries dataset metadata](https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/KGZ/ADM1/)
- [OpenStreetMap attribution and ODbL](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright)
- [Sulaiman-Too UNESCO listing](https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/1230/)
- [Kyrgyzstan flag source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Flag_of_Kyrgyzstan.svg) (public domain national flag)

The 53 postcard illustrations were individually generated with OpenAI image generation. Exact prompts are in `art-prompts.json`. JPEG exports preserve the full generated composition and reduce download size; PNG originals remain in the local generated-image library and ignored `output/kg-art-originals` folder.

Vehicles: marshrutka, mountain bus (upgraded marshrutka portrait), mountain 4×4, northern passenger train, domestic plane, express coach and tunnel shuttle. Kyrgyzstan has no ferry or high-speed railway service in this campaign. Northern trains are restricted to the northern corridor. Surface routes cannot cross the illustrated lakes.

Wikipedia links in the atlas and questions provide further reading. Illustrations are artistic educational interpretations, rather than photographs or exact architectural surveys.
